primary.title: Compose your organ

intro.text: Choose a starting design and answer a few questions about the room, the sound and the front instruments. It takes a few minutes and gives us a clear starting point for the first conversation.

primary.note: Not a price calculator and not an order. Every organ is confirmed after a consultation.

primary.title: Pick a starting design

intro.text: Start from one of our modular organs or from a bespoke design we built before. Then choose where it will play, the size, pipes or digital, the voices and what plays in the front.

bespoke_note.text: Want something none of these designs show? Choose Start from scratch and describe your idea in the message. Bespoke organs start with a consultation and a 3D render, so nothing is fixed until you have seen it.

primary.success_title: Your starting point is on its way

success_body.text: Thank you. Your choices are with us in Herentals. We reply with questions and a first idea.

answer.text: No. It is a request for a consultation, not an order. Nothing is fixed until you confirm an order with us.

items.question: What happens after I send it?

answer.text: We read your choices and reply with questions and a first idea. Then we talk through the room, the music and the budget, and work towards a design and a 3D render. See how we build an organ.
Yes. Choose Start from scratch and describe what you have in mind. Every option can be changed later, and a fully bespoke organ is always possible.
